# Monero explorer support

The live explorer is [xmr.tx.taxi](https://xmr.tx.taxi). Check [service status](https://status.tx.taxi) for current availability.

Contact the tx.taxi maintainer at [t.me/hiss](https://t.me/hiss) for support, translation contributions, or private reports. When reporting a bug, include the affected page URL, what you expected, what happened, and your browser or device. Share only public chain identifiers; never send private keys, recovery phrases, or credentials.

This repository maintains the tx.taxi Monero explorer. Please keep tx.taxi deployment and product questions with tx.taxi support.
